entities.summary: Thomas Blug (b. 1966, Saarbrücken) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Saarbrücken and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
